sms_policy.sms_scope_rule: Reminder-only SMS is allowed for dashboard-linked jobs and required items with explicit contact linkage.
sms_policy.sensitive_content_rule: Do not include documents, approvals, private notes, staff names, or operational detail beyond the reminder purpose.
sms_policy.secure_link_rule: Only share the governed dashboard or request-files link that already maps to the required item.
sms_policy.opt_in_rule: Only opted-in contacts with a valid normalized phone number are eligible for sends.
sms_policy.opt_out_rule: Any provider or manual opt-out immediately blocks future reminder sends until re-consented.
sms_policy.manual_override_rule: Manual SMS sends are allowed only through governed templates and remain fully logged.
sms_policy.consent_retention_rule: Consent changes and opt-out reasons remain durable for audit and compliance review.

kpi_definitions.title: Overdue Items
kpi_definitions.description: Count of incomplete required items past due and still in active intake flow.
kpi_definitions.target_rule: Keep overdue items at or below the current operational threshold.
kpi_definitions.data_rule: Count incomplete required items with due_at earlier than now.

kpi_definitions.title: Review Cycle Hours
kpi_definitions.description: Median review time from submission receipt to approval or rejection.
kpi_definitions.target_rule: Keep review cycle inside the review SLA threshold.
kpi_definitions.data_rule: Use submission timestamps and final reviewer decision timestamps.

kpi_definitions.title: Upload Turnaround Hours
kpi_definitions.description: Average time from reminder send to matched upload receipt.
kpi_definitions.target_rule: Reduce upload turnaround by improving reminders and request clarity.
kpi_definitions.data_rule: Compare reminder delivery timestamp to next matched submission timestamp.

kpi_definitions.title: Reminder Effectiveness
kpi_definitions.description: Percent of reminder sends that lead to a matched upload within the configured effectiveness window.
kpi_definitions.target_rule: Track effectiveness trend and retire low-signal reminder patterns.
kpi_definitions.data_rule: Matched upload within the effectiveness window divided by reminder sends.

kpi_definitions.title: Operational Backlog
kpi_definitions.description: Open intake items that remain incomplete and still require client action or review.
kpi_definitions.target_rule: Keep backlog visible and below the weekly operational limit.
kpi_definitions.data_rule: Count active mappings with incomplete work and no terminal submission outcome.

sla_definitions.title: Submission Review SLA
sla_definitions.description: Submission review should be completed within the defined hours after receipt.
sla_definitions.breach_rule: A breach occurs when a submission stays open for review past 48 hours.

sla_definitions.title: Client Upload SLA
sla_definitions.description: Required item uploads should arrive within the expected follow-up window.
sla_definitions.breach_rule: A breach occurs when required items remain incomplete more than 72 hours past due.

optimization_rules.bottleneck_grouping_rule: Group by department scope first, then by reminder flow and required-item record type.

execution_order.title: Validate SMS compliance policy and approved sender numbers.
execution_order.rollback: Disable outbound SMS endpoints before removing numbers from the baseline.

execution_order.title: Configure flow endpoints and callback secret in the target environment.
execution_order.rollback: Clear the SMS endpoint configuration and disable the feature flag.

execution_order.title: Pilot opt-in capture and manual consent import for target contacts.
execution_order.rollback: Set consent status to opted_out or suppressed for the pilot contacts.

execution_order.title: Enable reminder sweep and validate callbacks and failure alerts.
execution_order.rollback: Disable reminder sweeps and callback processing while preserving delivery logs.

manual_admin_checklist.step: Approve the reminder-only SMS policy and verify the sender number is licensed for the environment.
Create or validate the flow endpoints used for reminder, overdue, and manual reminder sends.
Route provider failures into the Teams Automation Alerts channel.
Run the Phase 8 validation script before enabling the feature flag.

validation_checklist: Confirm SMS templates never expose sensitive content.
Confirm only opted-in contacts can be queued for SMS delivery.
Confirm failed provider callbacks surface in diagnostics and Teams Automation Alerts.
Confirm KPI and SLA summaries map back to dashboard-linked records.
rollback_principles: Disable outbound SMS before changing sender numbers or callback routes.
Preserve consent and delivery history even when the feature is rolled back.
Pause reminder sweeps instead of deleting mappings or delivery records.
